news.title: Security Feature Updates for Okta Classic Engine
news.text: Okta introduced new security features to the Classic Engine, including enhanced validation rules for user profile attributes in the OIN Wizard.

news.title: Okta and Palo Alto Networks Unify AI-Driven Security
news.text: Okta partnered with Palo Alto Networks to integrate AI-powered identity and security capabilities aimed at combating identity-driven attacks.

news.title: Okta Reports Q2 FY2026 Results
news.text: Okta posted second-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue and EPS ahead of expectations, highlighting 13% year-over-year growth, margin expansion, and strength among large enterprise customers.

news.title: Okta Launches New AI-Driven Identity Innovations
news.text: Okta unveiled new identity security fabric capabilities designed to protect AI-driven enterprises and combat fraud.

news.title: GSA Renews Okta FedRAMP Authorization
news.text: Okta announced the U.S. General Services Administration renewed FedRAMP authorization for its government identity services, reinforcing its public sector footprint.
